aviation_incidents.headline: 華航CI840曼谷滑行遇地面破洞 737機輪卡陷、旅客滯留一晚
aviation_incidents.summary: 中華航空CI840班機原訂10月28日晚間18時35分自曼谷素萬那普機場飛往高雄小港機場，由波音737-800客機（註冊編號B-18665）執飛。飛機在地面滑行準備起飛時，滑行道地面出現一個大破洞，機輪卡進凹陷處、動彈不得，航班因此未能起飛。機上旅客在Threads發布的影像顯示，飛機在夜間停在停機坪上，起落架附近的鋪面破裂、碎塊散落，身穿反光背心的地勤人員在機旁處理。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: China Airlines CI840 Boeing 737 Stuck in Taxiway Pavement Hole at Bangkok
aviation_incidents.summary_en: China Airlines flight CI840 was scheduled to depart Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for Kaohsiung at 18:35 on October 28, operated by a Boeing 737-800 registered B-18665. While the aircraft was taxiing for departure, it encountered a large hole in the taxiway pavement; its wheels became trapped in the depression and the jet could not move, so the flight never departed. Video and photos posted by passengers on Threads show the aircraft stopped on the apron at night, with broken pavement and scattered debris beneath the fuselage near the landing gear as ground crew in high-visibility vests worked around it.

aviation_incidents.headline: 伏林航空A320特內里費前起落架轉向異常，盤旋處置後落地並拖離跑道
aviation_incidents.summary: 伏林航空一架空中巴士A320-200客機、註冊編號EC-LVV，執行VY-3030航班由巴塞隆納飛往特內里費北部機場（TFN），在進場特內里費時因前起落架轉向出現問題，機組員爬升回到FL070高度等待，依檢查表處置。約30分鐘後，飛機重新定位，降落在30跑道。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Vueling A320 holds over Tenerife with nose gear steering problem, then lands and is towed off runway
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Vueling Airbus A320-200, registration EC-LVV, operating flight VY-3030 from Barcelona to Tenerife Norte, was on approach to Tenerife when the crew climbed back to a hold at FL070 to work the checklists after a problem with the nose gear steering developed. The aircraft then positioned for a landing on runway 30 about 30 minutes after entering the hold.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚Harris來臺。Harris於美國時間10月26日搭乘貨機自達拉斯機場起飛，並於臺灣時間27日晚間10時26分抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）。長榮航空表示，航程約18個小時，休士頓動物園副園長及保衛員也隨行照料。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air transports male bongo antelope to Taiwan for breeding
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air transported a male bongo antelope named Harris to Taiwan. Harris departed Dallas Airport aboard a cargo aircraft on Oct. 26 U.S. time and arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 10:26 p.m. Taiwan time on Oct. 27. EVA Air said the flight took about 18 hours, with the Houston Zoo's deputy director and an animal-care staff member accompanying and caring for him.

taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwanese Carriers Fly Over Russian Airspace on European Routes, Transport Ministry Says
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai stated on October 28 that Taiwanese airlines recently flew over Russian airspace on select European routes. Chen noted that flight paths are requested independently by the airlines themselves, and the ministry respects their operational arrangements. The Civil Aeronautics Administration manages route origins and destinations, while specific flight paths remain subject to airline applications.

international_aviation.headline: 紐航與香港國際機場（HKG）率先取得IATA One ID認證
international_aviation.summary: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）宣布，紐西蘭航空與香港國際機場成為全球首批取得One ID認證的機構，認證在澳門舉行的IATA世界旅客研討會（WPS）上頒發。One ID是IATA為在旅客旅程中運用數位身分與生物辨識而制定的全球產業標準：旅客在抵達機場前先確認身分與旅行文件，之後在各查驗點以臉部辨識通關，不必反覆出示護照與登機證。這項新認證讓航空公司、機場與政府能確認，某個機構使用數位身分與生物辨識的方式符合IATA的全球標準。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air New Zealand and Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) First to Achieve IATA One ID Certification
international_aviation.summary_en: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) announced that Air New Zealand and Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) (HKIA) are the first organizations to achieve One ID Certification, with the certifications presented at the IATA World Passenger Symposium (WPS) in Macao. One ID is a set of global industry standards for using digital identity and biometrics across the passenger journey, supporting a journey where passengers confirm their identity and travel documents before reaching the airport, then pass through checkpoints using facial recognition instead of repeatedly showing their passport and boarding pass. The new certification gives airlines, airports, and governments assurance that an organization's use of digital identity and biometrics meets IATA's global One ID standards.

international_aviation.headline: 波音坦承737MAX交機目標落空：機翼產能不足，500架目標無法達成
international_aviation.summary: 波音坦承將無法達成2026年交付約500架737MAX的目標，原因是機翼產能跟不上。2026年前九個月波音已交付367架737，若要達標，第四季還需再交付133架；第三季每月平均僅略高於41架，低於最後一季每月約44架的需求。執行長在財報電話會議上確認，機翼生產仍是737MAX生產最主要的限制因素；所有737MAX機翼都在Renton製造，且屬於最先組裝的主要部件之一，因此任何放緩都會限制整體生產計畫。波音表示，優先事項是先穩定生產，並建立可交付安全且高品質飛機的體系。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing admits it will miss 500-jet 737 MAX delivery target as wing output lags
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing has confirmed it will miss its target of delivering about 500 737 MAX aircraft in 2026, because wing production cannot keep pace. The company delivered 367 737s in the first nine months of 2026, leaving 133 deliveries needed in the fourth quarter to reach the target, while the third-quarter average was just above 41 per month, below the roughly 44 per month required in the final quarter. Chief Executive Kelly Ortberg said on the company's earnings call that wing production remains the main constraint on 737 MAX output, noting that all 737 MAX wings are built at Renton and are among the first major parts assembled, so any slowdown there limits the whole production plan.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍將洛克希德馬丁ARRW極音速飛彈投入量產
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍部10月26日宣布，已授予洛克希德馬丁一份6.94億美元合約，生產並部署AGM-183A空射快速反應武器（ARRW）。這份合約實際上已在9月29日授出，屬於美國戰爭部的全企業敏捷採購合約；空軍部基於作戰安全考量，沒有公布採購數量與開始交付的時間。空軍部長Troy Meink表示，ARRW象徵一個轉折點，是一款能以高速穿透先進防空系統的武器。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Air Force puts Lockheed Martin's troubled hypersonic ARRW into production
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Air Force has awarded Lockheed Martin a $694 million contract to produce and field the AGM-183A Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon (ARRW), the Department of the Air Force announced on October 26, 2026. The contract had been awarded on September 29, 2026, under the Department of War's Enterprise-Wide Agile Acquisition Contract. Citing operational security, the department did not disclose how many weapons were ordered or when deliveries would begin. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink described ARRW as a turning point and as a high-speed weapon able to penetrate advanced air defenses.
